_comment: docs/misc/col4-eval-harness.py against production at commit e41508f, one arm per model, same 150-string COL4 ru->fr sample (fingerprint 4db4b89dfd4b), batch 10 and concurrency 2 everywhere. EVAL_MODEL routes every language to one model for the run without touching the stored configuration. Costs are for the 150-string sample; a full 3941-string run is 26 times that.
_findings: gemini-2.5-flash is the best of the cheap tier and the fastest: 28 end_stop of 150 strings against 48 for mistral-medium-3.1 and 53 for deepseek-chat-v3.1, with no wasted replies. Public benchmark standing holds on this task too.

gemini-2.5-pro is the only model with zero punctuation defects, and it keeps coverage and glossary at 100%. It costs 23 times more ($21 for a full run) and takes 29 times longer (about 6.4 hours for a full run at concurrency 2). Single run, unlike the others it has not been repeated.
Every model that answered kept glossary adherence at 100% and leaked no Cyrillic, so those are properties of the prompt, not of the model.
gpt-5-mini cannot be used as we ask: the provider returns 400 for our reply schema (probed directly; plain requests and temperature are fine).
claude-haiku-4.5 accepts a simple schema when probed directly but produced no parsable reply under the real payload; not chased further.
A model that fails every request costs 285 requests instead of 15, because a hard error keeps splitting the batch in halves. Worth bounding if such a model is ever configured.
